title: Introduce quiet-window sampling and Mosaic metric adapters for token burst noise suppression
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: production token bursts from background jobs and chatfanout generate high-cardinality short-lived noise that skews percentile-based alerts and dilutes useful tail traces. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: 1) a configurable quiet-window sampler that temporarily de-emphasizes bursts matching short high-throughput token patterns so SLO signals reflect real user-facing latency/cost instead of backend batch noise; 2) Mosaic metric adapters, a lightweight adapter layer that coalesces related token-phase counters, kernel latency samples, and queueing gauges into a small set of composite metrics and tags for dashboards and alert rules. Approach: quiet-window sampling detects burst windows per-route and per-tenant using a sliding token-rate estimator and applies an adjustable attenuation factor to sampling probability and cost attribution for spans that are classified as background-burst. Mosaic adapters implement a mapping layer in the telemetry pipeline that emits aggregated metrics (mosaic.token_rate, mosaic.kernel_p50, mosaic.queueing_p95) alongside original granular metrics to preserve observability. Safety and rollout: default behavior is off; feature flags gate behavior at tenant-level with conservative defaults; we ship an opt-in rollout for internal tenants for 2 weeks, collect comparison diffs, then flip progressively. Backwards compatibility: no change to existing metric names or span schemas; adapters emit new mosaic.* series only. Monitoring and testing: added comparison dashboards, a synthetic burst generator for canary verification, and unit+integration tests. Impact: expected reduction in false-positive SLO alerts for noisy tenants and clearer long-tail attributions for genuine slow invocations. See notes and examples below for configuration and thresholds.

Opt-in rollout controlled by tenant flag. Improves SLO signal fidelity without changing existing metrics.
notes_for_ops: Default off; enable via feature flag 'observability.quiet_window' on a per-tenant basis. Config knobs: window_ms, token_rate_threshold, attenuation_factor. Use the mosaic_comparison dashboard to compare original vs mosaic series before promoting to wide rollout.
deploy_instructions: Apply telemetry/config/defaults.yaml to control plane, restart telemetry service with zero-downtime config reload via SIGHUP, enable feature-flag for target tenant, monitor mosaic_comparison dashboard for 48h.
